description:
Define the issue-construction fixture once in shared test support, so the five copies can be retired.

## Background

`fixture_issue(title, description)` drafts an issue and assigns it a random UUID. It is defined five times with the same body: in `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs` as a `pub(crate)` function for library unit tests, and in the suite roots of `fast_issue`, `fast_docs_templates`, `cli_query_graph` and `fast_rules`. `crate::test_utils` is compiled for library unit tests and, under `test-support`, for every integration target.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crate::test_utils` defines `fixture_issue` with the body of the existing copies, reachable from library unit tests and integration suites.
title: Shared issue-construction fixture
